models.name: NOAA CFSv2
models.note: NOAA CFSv2 · 40-member ensemble · init 1 Nov 2026 · read directly from NCEP CPC. The absolute snowfall is ERA5's 1991-2020 climatology plus the CFSv2 hindcast anomaly (an approximation — CPC publishes the anomaly only). NOAA publishes no 10 hPa winds, so this model has snowfall panels only — no zonal-wind panel.
